_meta.comment: Per-locale copy for the Habit2Goal social/preview banner (Open Graph image). Edit text here, then run `node build.mjs` to regenerate assets/og-image-<locale>.png. Numeric fields (eyebrowWidth, headlineSize, ctaWidth) are layout hints so translators can fit longer strings without touching the SVG.
